headings.strategy: Swiss Brutalist (Tech/Art) inspired - strong, clear, authoritative

body.strategy: Clean, highly legible for dense data

rules: No full-screen gradients. Focus on flat, solid high-contrast colors.
The 'Tinted Grey' Rule: Tint neutral greys with slight blue (#F8F9FA) for a clean tech feel.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds on sticky headers or overlays. Use solid or heavily blurred backgrounds.
Use Accent (#0066FF) strictly for CTAs and interactive triggers. Do NOT overuse.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look) - 1px subtle borders on grid items and cards to expose the skeleton.
visual_enhancers.radius: Subtle roundness, max 8px border-radius (rounded-md to rounded-lg).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use crisp edges via semi-transparent borders. Soft ambient shadow (shadow-sm) only on hover for interactive cards.
visual_enhancers.textures: Flat and solid. No glassmorphism (glass on data-heavy apps feels clinical and creates visual refraction).

rules: Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 for main stats.
Widgets: Primary data charts take col-span-2 or col-span-3. Summaries take col-span-1.
Spacing: Generous internal padding (p-4 to p-6) inside bordered containers to prevent text collision.

general: Use Shadcn/UI heavily for logical flow (tables, forms, select, dialogs, tabs).
DO NOT use generic HTML inputs (e.g., <select> or <input type='date'>). Use Shadcn counterparts.
Override Shadcn defaults where necessary to match the 8px radius and Swiss color scheme.

specific.cards: Go cardless where possible, or use flat rectangular styles with 1px border. No drop-shadows by default.
specific.tables: Dense rows. Left-align text, right-align numbers. Sticky headers for long inventory lists.
specific.buttons: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md). High contrast on hover (e.g., hover:bg-primary/90).

rules: Hover states on all interactive elements (buttons, table rows, links).
Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors duration-200), NEVER 'transition-all'.
Focus states must have HIGHER contrast (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent).

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for text below 18px. Minimum 3:1 for large text and interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

rules: Keep imagery extremely minimal as this is an internal ops dashboard.
If empty states or illustrative blocks are needed, use the provided conceptual URLs.

image_urls.description: Minimal warehouse shelves, useful for empty state of 'No Stock Found'
Dispatch boxes on a dolly, useful for 'Dispatch Party' section empty state or header

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust Dashboard/Internal Ops app covering: Sales/Dispatch Stats, Customer Management, Inventory, Order Entry, PO to Company, Party-wise Dispatch.
Implement Role Switch (Staff/Admin) via a simple UI toggle in the header (no actual auth required for now).
Use light theme by default as it is an operational data entry tool.
Focus on data density and clear information architecture.
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide-react for sharp, recognizable iconography.
All logic should be mocked cleanly in .js files until backend integration is specified.
Use Shadcn UI components extensively to maintain consistent, accessible interactive elements.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use optical alignment.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, though for dashboards prefer flat structural layering over deep shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles (max 8px radius for this app) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, focus states, and entrance animations.
Use generous spacing inside components (p-4 to p-6 for cards).
Subtle grain textures or custom selection states separate good from extraordinary.
Missing categories = placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use the provided URLs.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Create new components that match the style when needed.
